title: JourneyPage
description: data/running/owner/journey/page.yaml: the story page's own wording (specs/003-journey-story/data-model.md §8). Required once any chapter exists (FR-039). Only approved text may enter this file.

title.description: Required plain text, at most 70 characters. The <h1> and the start of <title>.
title.x-error: must be one line of at most 70 characters

description.description: Required plain text, at most 160 characters. The meta description and share description.
description.x-error: must be one line of at most 160 characters

share_text.description: Required plain text, at most 90 characters, no digits (FR-075: the share image carries no figure).
share_text.x-error: must be one line of at most 90 characters with no digit: the share image carries no figure

link_label.description: Required plain text. Must equal section.yaml story_link.label.

approved.description: The owner's approval, written by scripts/approve-story.ts --journey after their explicit yes. sha256 covers the file's hashed fields (data-model.md §2).
approved.x-error: needs the owner's approval before it can be published

date.description: The date the owner approved the file. Not in the future.

sha256.description: 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters: the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the hashed fields. A mismatch means the file changed after approval.
sha256.x-error: is not a sha256 (64 lower-case hexadecimal characters)
